description: Draw a .glb as text for agents that cannot see pictures: front, side and top views made of letters (one letter per part), a table of the parts with sizes, and the parts that do not touch the rest (a wheel without an axle, a roof above its house). Use it after every build to check shape, proportions and that everything is attached. Read-only.

title: See a model as text
